title: DivinexisMace
description: Advanced mace cooldown system with visual cooldowns and customizable particle effects for Paper 1.21+
body:
DivinexisMace

Advanced mace cooldowns and customizable particle effects for Minecraft Paper 1.21+

Features

Real Mace Cooldown System

DivinexisMace uses Paper's native cooldown API to provide a true cooldown system for maces.

- Visual cooldown displayed directly on the mace in the hotbar
- Prevents mace spam and abuse
- Configurable cooldown duration
- Action bar cooldown notifications
- Lightweight and optimized

Custom Particle Effects

Choose your own combat style with five unique particle effects:

- RED – Red critical-hit aura
- BLUE – Magical blue energy burst
- FIRE – Flames and lava sparks
- LIGHTNING – Electric energy effects
- BLOOD – Dark red impact burst

Particle selections are saved automatically and are visible to nearby players.

Modern GUI

- Easy-to-use inventory GUI
- Visual indicator for selected particle
- Sound feedback when selecting effects
- Clean and user-friendly design

Commands

Player Commands

- "/divinexismace-particles"
- "/dmaceparticles"
- "/dmparticles"

Open the particle selection menu.

Admin Commands

- "/divinexismace <time>"
- "/dmace <time>"
- "/dmacecooldown <time>"

Examples:

- "/dmace 10s"
- "/dmace 30s"
- "/dmace 1m"
- "/dmace 2m"

Permissions

- "divinexismace.admin" – Access admin commands
- "divinexismace.use" – Use mace cooldown system
- "divinexismace.particles" – Access particle GUI

Requirements

- Paper 1.21+
- Java 21+

No external dependencies required.

Configuration

Fully configurable through:

- "config.yml"

Adjust cooldown duration, particle density, and messages to fit your server.

Installation

1. Download the latest release.
2. Place "DivinexisMace.jar" inside your server's "plugins" folder.
3. Restart or reload your server.
4. Configure the plugin to your liking.

Video Link!
https://youtu.be/U8MIq8Nq5QA?si=hy4LTIUQpqCpZgkH

Why DivinexisMace?

Unlike many simple cooldown plugins, DivinexisMace uses Paper's native cooldown system, providing proper visual feedback while keeping performance impact minimal. Combined with customizable combat particles, it creates a more engaging PvP experience for your players.

Made for Divinexis Network
